results.title: SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer
results.summary: Proposes selective KV cache transfer between disaggregated prefill and decode nodes via profile-based proactive, parallel on-demand, and speculative transfer paths, reducing time-to-second-token by up to 4.3x versus full KV cache transfer.

results.title: Prefill-as-a-Service: KVCache of Next-Generation Models Could Go Cross-Datacenter
results.summary: Argues that hybrid-attention architectures shrink KV cache enough to offload long-context prefill to standalone compute-dense prefill clusters and stream KV cache over commodity Ethernet to local decode clusters, reporting 54% higher throughput and 64% lower P90 TTFT on an internal 1T-parameter model.

results.title: SpectrumKV: Per-Token Mixed-Precision KV Cache Transfer for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
results.summary: Reframes PD KV transfer as a per-token precision-allocation problem (FP16/INT8/INT4 by token importance) rather than binary pruning, achieving 50-62% TTFT reductions with a deployment-time probe to gauge per-model INT4 tolerance.

results.title: Disaggregated Inference: 18 Months Later
results.summary: Retrospective by the DistServe authors on how prefill-decode disaggregation and KV cache handoff evolved across production systems (NVIDIA Dynamo, LMCache, Mooncake), and outlines future directions including attention-FFN disaggregation.

results.title: Topology-Aware KV Transfer
results.summary: Official documentation for NVIDIA Dynamo's topology-aware KV transfer feature, which constrains decode worker selection after remote prefill so KV cache is handed off only within disaggregated prefill/decode deployments via NIXL.

results.title: [RFC]: Implement disaggregated prefilling via KV cache transfer #5557
results.summary: The foundational RFC proposing disaggregated prefilling in vLLM via communicator and KV-database abstractions that transfer KV cache from prefilling instances to decoding instances.

results.title: Prefill/Decode Disaggregation (Ray Serve LLM User Guide)
results.summary: Official Ray Serve documentation on separating prefill and decode phases, including the NIXLConnector for network-based KV cache transfer between prefill and decode servers.
